personalization/data.description: Emitted when personalization data is loaded or updated. This includes user segments, personalized content, and targeting information.

personalization.description: Personalization data including user segments, preferences, and personalized content recommendations.

personalization/error.description: Emitted when an error occurs during personalization operations such as loading segments or fetching personalized content.

error.description: Error details including message, code, and context about which personalization operation failed.

personalization/initialized.description: Emitted when the personalization component completes initialization. This indicates the personalization engine is ready to deliver targeted content.

segment/updated.description: Emitted when the user's segment assignment changes. This event is useful for updating personalized content based on user behavior or profile changes.

segments.description: Array of segment IDs that the user is currently assigned to, used for targeting and personalization.
